title: Kagamine Rin — Be Quiet During The Movie!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're here...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, heya, An!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <N-Not so loud, Rin!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Len, you're being just as loud!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're being the loudest of all, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. My apologies.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry too much since they just opened the doors to let the audience in and they're all chatting pretty loudly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, you're right. There's a ton of people here!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys mentioned that you wanted to get a better feel for the atmosphere, so it'll be important to see what it's like to both put on an event and be in the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: This event's got such a good lineup! Just famous teams left and right!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah, especially Vivid BAD SQUAD. They've been on a roll since successfully putting on their own event.

rows.Speaker: Spectator C
rows.Line: No way, dude. If you want a team that's on a roll, you gotta think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa...! They're all really excited about this event!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll need to do our best to make sure they enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we should head backstage soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we can leave them here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you, An, Kohane♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Good luck with your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll come straight back once we're finished.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Have fun!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Just a little bit longer until it starts.
I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me neither. I'm glad I decided to join you all.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <By the way, Rin, how do you feel? Are you getting a good sense of the atmosphere?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Good point. The calm before the storm's very important.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Try looking at all the teams standing by in the wings to perform. Keep in mind that people are the ones who have to create a good atmosphere.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The atmosphere's...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <...created by people.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Remember that Nagi person's performance?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, that's right!>

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team A
rows.Line: This event's just wall-to-wall A-listers...

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team B
rows.Line: Hey, now's not the time for that! Remember how long it took us to get here!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team C
rows.Line: Right! If we can get the crowd on our side at an event like this, we'll start getting instant name recognition!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We're in the neighborhood where that legendary event happened, so we gotta do everything we can to achieve that!

rows.Speaker: No-Name Team B & C
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team A
rows.Line: Looks like we got some good ones today. I've never seen them before, but we should keep an eye out to see how they do.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team B
rows.Line: But Vivid BAD SQUAD's gotta be the favorites for today...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team C
rows.Line: Yup. This is our first time performing in an event with them, since we were in a different city for a while...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team B
rows.Line: We used to perform around here a lot too, but they're the ones everybody's talking about now.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Team A
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's take this opportunity to remind them that we're also here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-This is getting kinda scary...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It is a battle after all. Isn't this sorta normal?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, right. This event's a competition.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Exactly. The atmosphere that's created here should be fairly different from the event that Akito and the others put on, as well as from RAD WEEKEND.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Since everyone's singing with different goals in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Different goals...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Remember what the people from that one team were saying? They want to get their name out there.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thus, it's only natural for most teams to go into this event believing that they'll be able to sing their way to the top and say in the end, “We're the best!”>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That explains the tension in the air...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <At the same time, you'll only feel that tension right now.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Once the event starts, each team will do their best to get the crowd on their side and turn the tides in their favor.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I think it's about to begin.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I know you've both been looking forward to this event, but try not to forget that we're here to get a feel for the atmosphere, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <K-KAITO's acting like a real teacher...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Ouch.
I can put on a serious face when I need to...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha! But your actions leave so much to be desired most other times...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Speak for yourself, Luka!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Quiet, you two!>

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: <S-Sorry...>

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Haha!>
